content:
Force on Moving Charge — Quick Reference

Key Formulas / Values

F = q(E + v × B), where F is the force on the moving charge, q is the magnitude of the charge, E is the electric field, v is the velocity of the charge, and B is the magnetic field.
F_E = qE for electric force and F_B = qvB sin(θ) for magnetic force, with θ being the angle between v and B.

Mnemonics

Right-hand rule for magnetic force: thumb (v), fingers (B), palm (F), for a positive charge.

Key Points

  • Electric force acts parallel to the electric field.
  • Magnetic force acts perpendicular to both the magnetic field and the velocity of the charge.
  • The magnitude of the magnetic force depends on the sine of the angle between the velocity and the magnetic field.
  • For a negative charge, the direction of the force is opposite to that for a positive charge.
